Concept sheet drawn from the spec note's parts table (tools/blocky/sheet.py); blocky style rules: Blocky-Style.md
Parts (the note's table; mirror x makes an R and an L)
Face plate: `gem` (Epic eye), 28 x 14 px at 16 a stud, 5 frames
Silhouettes at 64 px (black shape, each view in its own frame)
Element: Crystal. VFX: kept on the body (Epic), five layers in Effects.luau: a lilac glint
twinkles on the left wing (BackL) and a pale blue one on the right (BackR) every 3 s, a slow
lilac dust drifts down from the back at 4 a second, a violet light pulses on the back, and the
signature: every 7 s and on the flourish the wings shake out a burst of fourteen pink prism
sparkles. The flourish (every 10 s) is a wing-shake: a hop, the fore and hind wings flared, the
antennae swishing and the gold shard leaping
